title: Day Flight 48 Miles Helicopter Tour over Theme Parks & Downtown
blurb:
Once you take off you will go over Aquatica, Epic Universe (new theme park), ICON Park, Orlando Eye, Universal Studios, Island of Adventures, Volcano Bay, then you will take quick detour to Downtown Orlando to see the cityscape, Camping World Stadium, KIA Center, and Lake Eola Park. On the return leg will be going over Disney Springs, Typhoon Lagoon, Blizzard Beach, Epcot (corner), Hollywood Studios, ESPN Sports Complex, Old Town, Fun Spot Kissimmee, and Give Kids the World Village. You may also catch a glimpse of Magic Kingdom and Animal Kingdom. 
It is a private helicopter tour! You will not be sharing the helicopter with other tour passengers. 
Every seat is a window seat on this exciting Helicopter Tour!
